title: Zesty Grassy Portuguese Pork Tenderloin Skewers
description: This dish features pork tenderloin marinated in a zesty and grassy mixture, inspired by Portuguese cuisine, and is garlic and onion free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities. The bhuna spice blend adds a unique and adventurous flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together bhuna spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork tenderloin pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the chopped parsley and mint in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are cooked, brush them with the parsley and mint mixture.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
